scripts.build:template: python3 tools/build_template.py "workbook/Product Designer Task Manager (original).xlsx" workbook/template.xlsx
scripts.test:rules: cd firebase && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-dth "node --test ../tests/rules.test.js"
scripts.serve: cd firebase && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,hosting --project demo-dth
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cd firebase && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules
